io.milvus.orm.iterator

Class QueryIterator

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.orm.iterator.QueryIterator

  • public class QueryIterator
extends Object
    Iterates over query results in batches using a session timestamp and primary-key based cursor, supporting offset seeking, resumable cursors, and element-filter iteration.

      • getCursor

        public QueryIteratorCursor getCursor()
        Capture the current iterator position as a resumable cursor. The cursor holds the session timestamp, the last primary key returned, and (for element-filter iterators) the last matched element offset, so pagination can continue in a new iterator.
        Returns:
        the resumable cursor capturing the current iterator position
